items.title: Fourth member of Burlington family dies following townhouse fire; 1 child remains in hospital
items.summary: A fourth member of a Burlington family has died following a devastating townhouse fire that critically injured five people last weekend. In a statement released Thursday, Burlington Mayor Marianne Meed Ward said the tragedy has now claimed the lives of four family members, including two parents…
